title: Lifetime Subscription – Beware of the Scam
body: This app is a scam. Don’t subscribe. I purchased the lifetime unlimited plan, but one day, I got a pop-up offering the ‘lifetime’ premium plan again, and my account was downgraded from premium. I checked the settings in the app to verify my account status, and it showed ‘Basic account.’ This app is deceiving. The app itself is good, but it’s not truly a lifetime deal as advertised

title: Simple, Clean, Friendly to use But too little choices for sub-plan
body: The app is designed very well, the function is good and easy to use. But I think the subscription plan choice is too little to choose. For the beginner who never uses the app to track their habits that much as me, I think paying for a year is too long a commitment. You should have a monthly or weekly sub-plan to let the users try to use your app in a premium way. Then if your app is really good and makes users enjoy using your app, long-term subscribed will be happened for willingly.
